prompt: ApiLimiter and LoginLimiter in src/limiters.js both carry their own copy of the same refill-and-spend logic. Pull that logic out into one reusable token bucket exported as TokenBucket from src/token-bucket.js, constructed with { capacity, refillPerMs, now } and offering tryTake(n = 1) (returns true or false), available() (whole tokens currently available) and msUntil(n = 1) (milliseconds until n tokens are available, 0 if already). Both limiters should use it, and their existing behavior must not change.
